killedBy: showcase validator (issue #1062) negative controls rule 15: an img tag whose title attribute holds a src
showcase validator (issue #1062) negative controls rule 15: an img tag with a single-quoted src
why: Rule 15: an attribute value may be single-quoted, and is read whole. Otherwise a single-quoted src is not a GIF, and a src written inside another attribute's value is read in place of the real one.
